notes.title: Elementallis FREE DEMO available during the IWOCon 2021
notes.content:
Hello Elementallists!

[b]Elementallis [/b]is attending the [b]IWOCon 2021[/b], a FREE digital indie game convention! We will have a virtual booth at [b]Love Islands[/b]. Come visit us!

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1422300/IWOCon_2021/]Visit the convention here![/url]
[/list]

[b]During the convention, our demo will be public. Check out the first Temple in Elementallis and gather the FIre Element![/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304280/Elementallis/]Download the DEMO[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Live Stream with developer 📢
notes.content:
We will be playing the demo on a live stream on Saturday 20th at 8 AM PDT / 5 PM CEST

Join us to check the demo and ask us anything you want in the chat.

See you there!
~Iván

[h3]About the game[/h3]

[b]Elementallis [/b]is a top-down adventure inspired by the classics from Gameboy where the use of elements (fire, water, wind, earth...) enhances combat and is needed to solve puzzles.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304280/Elementallis/

notes.content:

[h2][b]Play the demo when it launches on June 16th and then [url=https://discord.gg/PCYHASD]join us on Discord[/url] for a live chat with the developer to ask anything you want[/b][/h2]

[b]When[/b]: Wednesday June 17th at 11 AM PDT / 8 PM CEST
[b]Where[/b]: [url=https://discord.gg/PCYHASD]Our Discord server[/url]


The chat will last for roughly 2 hours, but I’ll also be available for questions during the Summer Festival, either on [url=https://discord.gg/PCYHASD]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/elementallis]Twitter (@elementallis)[/url] or here on Steam. Feel free to say hello whenever you want!

[i]Don’t forget to set a reminder by clicking the blue button. I hope to see you there![/i]

~Iván
